title: Siman 405
section: The Immense Preciousness of His Rosh Hashana

segments.he: גַּם-כֵּן כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ לִחְיוֹת, כִּי אִם לָאו חַס וְשָׁלוֹם יִסְתַּלֵּק בְּלֹא עִתּוֹ וְעַל-כֵּן בְּהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה רָצוֹא וָשׁוֹב:
segments.en: (3.) He answered and said: "My Rosh Hashana is a great novelty — and Hashem Yisburach knows this matter is not an inheritance from my forebears. Rather Hashem Yisburach gave this to me as a gift — that I know what Rosh Hashana is. Not to mention all of you — you are certainly dependent on my Rosh Hashana. But even the entire world entirely is dependent on my Rosh Hashana."
